Slim Shady by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Slim Shady offers a modern and exquisitely decorated retreat in the heart of historic Seagrove Beach. This thoughtfully designed courtyard home spans 2,819 sq. ft., comfortably accommodating up to 14 guests with ample parking available for your entire party. Adorned with plush furnishings, a cozy fireplace, and a large TV, the living space has a generous seating area. Family will also gather around the expansive quartz island countertop that seamlessly connects the living room to the impressive chef’s kitchen. With top-of-the-line appliances, which includes a 6-burner gas range, double wall ovens, two dishwashers, and an oversized fridge, the kitchen is a culinary delight. The primary bedroom, king, offers a private bath, and is positioned at the front of the home for added privacy.

Down the hall reveals a walk-in food pantry, spacious laundry room, and a beautiful view of the courtyard. The home’s unique layout also features a second living room and a fully stocked kitchen on the opposite end, providing convenience and flexibility. A second primary bedroom, king, a 6 bed bunk room with a private bath, along with two more queen guest rooms, sharing an adjoining jack and jill bathroom. The tranquil oasis of the private pool out back will sure to be a vacation highlight! Step into luxury, where the whole family can unwind in style. The courtyard and pool, with spacious table and chairs, is accessible from multiple points within the home, inviting cherished moments of togetherness. With its spacious design and thoughtful layout, Slim Shady is an unforgettable beach getaway, combining luxury with accessibility. Truly wonderful. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 860 steps (.4 miles) to the Santa Clara Public Beach Access (beach wheel chair available) - Single level Seagrove home - Wheelchair and handicap accessible throughout - Six Seater Golf Cart - 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath - Propane grill - 2819 sq ft - Private pool, 8'x20' (can be seasonally heated for $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Wi-Fi included - 4 bikes included - Parking limited to 4 vehicles with no street parking Overnight: - King in primary bedroom 1st floor; private shower; TV - King 1st floor; private bath; TV - Three twin over twin bunkbeds; private bath; TV - Queen bed in 1st floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV - Queen bed in 1st floor guest room; shared hall bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
